info.name: Amazon Security Lake Data Lakes API
Amazon Security Lake List Data Lakes

params.name: regions
params.description: List of regions to include in the response.

items.docs: Lists information about the data lakes in the current AWS account and Region.

info.name: Amazon Security Lake Create Data Lake

items.docs: Creates a Security Lake data lake in the specified regions. Security Lake begins ingesting security data after you create the data lake.

info.name: Amazon Security Lake Update Data Lake

params.name: dataLakeArn
params.description: The ARN of the data lake to update.

items.docs: Updates the configuration of a data lake.

info.name: Amazon Security Lake Delete Data Lake

params.name: dataLakeArn
params.description: The ARN of the data lake to delete.

items.docs: Deletes the Amazon Security Lake data lake configuration object for the specified account and Region.
